newsitem.title: USA: Motorola rises amid Nokia-Ericsson rumors.
newsitem.headline: Motorola rises amid Nokia-Ericsson rumors.

text.p: Motorola Inc's shares rose on Wednesday amid speculation that two leading mobile telephone companies were considering a merger.
The stock closed 2-3/4 higher at 56-3/8 in trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Market rumors suggested telecommunications rivals Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson and Nokia were planning a merger, overseas brokers said. The companies denied the rumors.
Many brokers had also discounted the rumors, but said the talk pushed shares of Ericsson and Nokia higher.
That enthusiam spilled over to Motorola, which also makes cellular systems, analysts said.
"Motorola's up on the Nokia rumors. I expect the stock will give back some of these gains when the enthusiasm quiets," said Scott Wright, an analyst with Argus Research.

Analysts also said Motorola's stock was ready for some moderate gains. The share price has been held back recently amid stiff competition in cellular phones and an industrywide slump in semiconductors, analysts said.
